step-1.text: Lay both desk tops upside down on the flattened box or a rug, pushed together into an L. This desk is built upside down.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 main desk top and 1 return top.

step-2.text: Screw the joining plates across the seam where the two tops meet. Check the edges are flush before you drive the last screw. The return goes on the left here, but it can go either way.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 joining plate and 8 screws.

step-3.text: Lay the frame beams along both tops and screw them down through the pre-drilled holes. The frame is what ties the L together, so use every screw.

count-3.text: This step uses 2 frame beams and 8 screws.

step-4.text: Bolt a leg into each corner bracket: two at the far end of the main top and two at the end of the return. Snug them, then go round once more and tighten.

count-4.text: This step uses 4 legs and 8 bolts.

step-5.text: With a helper, lift the whole desk and turn it onto its feet. Lift it clear of the floor, do not pivot it on one leg.

count-5.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-6.text: Push it into the corner and press on each end. If it rocks, twist the adjustable feet until all of them touch the floor.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your L01 l-shaped office desk 60" is built. Give it a proud little pat.
